description: ZeroTier is the closest Tailscale analog — software-defined L2/L3 overlay, peer-to-peer with relay fallback, identity via network membership. Has a local API (zerotier-cli) for caller identity similar to Tailscale WhoIs. Open source core (BSL). Most natural second overlay transport after Tailscale. Requires the abstract transport trait (KITH-lhaj).
title: Federation transport: ZeroTier overlay
